Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلَامَةِ بَدَنِي
Translation: O Allah, all praise be to You for the continued good health of my body

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِيْ مِنْ عِلَّةٍ فِيْ جَسَدِي
Translation: And all praise be to You for the illness You have brought upon my body

Arabic text: فَمَا أَدْرِي، يَا إِلَهِي، أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ
Translation: I do not know, my God, which of these two states is more deserving of gratitude to You

Arabic text: وَأَيُّ الْوَقْتَيْنِ أَوْلَى بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ
Translation: And which of the two times is more worthy of praise to You

Arabic text: أَ وَقْتُ الصِّحَّةِ الَّتِيْ هَنَّأْتَنِيْ فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ
Translation: Is it the time of health in which You made me enjoy the good things of Your provision

Arabic text: وَنَشَّطْتَنِيْ بِهَا لِابْتِغَاءِ مَرْضَاتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ
Translation: And in which You gave me energy to seek Your pleasure and bounty

Arabic text: وَقَوَّيْتَنِيْ مَعَهَا عَلَى مَا وَفَّقْتَنِيْ لَهُ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And gave me strength to perform the acts of obedience for which You granted me success

Arabic text: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِيْ مَحَّصْتَنِيْ بِهَا
Translation: Or is it the time of illness through which You purified me

Arabic text: وَالنِّعَمِ الَّتِيْ أَتْحَفْتَنِيْ بِهَا
Translation: And the blessings with which You honored me

Arabic text: تَخْفِيفًا لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهْرِيْ مِنَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
Translation: Lightening the burden of sins that weighed heavily on my back

Arabic text: وَتَطْهِيرًا لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
Translation: And purifying me from the evils in which I was immersed

Arabic text: وَتَنْبِيهًا لِتَنَاوُلِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَتَذْكِيرًا لِمَحْوِ الْحَوْبَةِ بِقَدِيمِ النِّعْمَةِ
Translation: And reminding me to seek repentance, and to erase sins through the remembrance of Your past favors

Arabic text: وَفِيْ خِلَالِ ذٰلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ
Translation: And during all that, what the two recording angels have written for me

Arabic text: مِنْ زَكِيِّ الْأَعْمَالِ، مَا لَا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ
Translation: Of pure deeds that no heart has contemplated

Arabic text: وَلَا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلَا جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ، بَلْ إِفْضَالًا مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: No tongue has uttered and no limb has performed, but only as Your favor upon me

Arabic text: وَإِحْسَانًا مِنْ صَنِيعِكَ إِلَيَّ
Translation: And as goodness from Your blessings to me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَحَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ مَا رَضِيتَ لِي
Translation: And make beloved to me what You have chosen for me

Arabic text: وَيَسِّرْ لِيْ مَا أَحْلَلْتَ بِي
Translation: And make easy for me what You have brought upon me

Arabic text: وَطَهِّرْنِيْ مِنْ دَنَسِ مَا أَسْلَفْتُ
Translation: And purify me from the impurity of my past deeds

Arabic text: وَامْحُ عَنِّيْ شَرَّ مَا قَدَّمْتُ
Translation: And erase the evil of what I have committed

Arabic text: وَأَوْجِدْنِيْ حَلَاوَةَ الْعَافِيَةِ، وَأَذِقْنِيْ بَرْدَ السَّلَامَةِ
Translation: And let me find the sweetness of well-being, and taste the coolness of safety

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِيْ عَنْ عِلَّتِيْ إِلَى عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And make my exit from my illness lead to Your pardon

Arabic text: وَمُتَحَوَّلِيْ عَنْ صَرْعَتِيْ إِلَى تَجَاوُزِكَ
Translation: And my transformation from my downfall lead to Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَخَلَاصِيْ مِنْ كَرْبِيْ إِلَى رَوْحِكَ
Translation: And my deliverance from my distress lead to Your comfort

Arabic text: وَسَلَامَتِيْ مِنْ هٰذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إِلَى فَرَجِكَ
Translation: And my safety from this hardship lead to Your relief

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ الْمُتَفَضِّلُ بِالْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: Verily, You are the One who bestows favors with kindness

Arabic text: اَلْمُتَطَوِّلُ بِالِامْتِنَانِ، الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ
Translation: The Giver of blessings, the Generous Bestower

Arabic text: ذُوْ الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
Translation: Possessor of Majesty and Honor
